actors.name: Ruth Kelleher
actors.private_context: Ruth has been trying to get the same three families away together since March. She has found Cove Cottage in Beadnell, £1,800 for the October half-term week (24th to 31st). She has already booked the week off and told her kids. She fronted £340 for a group meal last year and was still chasing the last of it in the spring, so she is not keen on being the one who covers people again. She received a call from Marian Prowse on Friday (presumably 11th September) saying a couple from Leeds have asked about that same week, and that Marian will hold it until the end of Wednesday (16th September) but not a day longer; she wants the £600 deposit in her bank account by then. That's £200 a household. Ruth is coordinating with Dev Sandhu and Nina Achebe.

actors.name: Dev Sandhu
actors.private_context: Dev is completely up for the trip and has said so twice in the thread. However, a new clutch took £620 off him a fortnight ago and he isn't paid until the 28th. He has a credit card he promised his wife he'd stop using. He is aware of the deposit requirement of £200 per household.

actors.name: Nina Achebe
actors.private_context: Nina hasn't replied at all in the thread. This is not out of rudeness, but because her mum came out of hospital after a fall three weeks ago and Nina genuinely doesn't know what October looks like yet. Saying that out loud would make it a thing she has to deal with. She is aware of the deposit requirement of £200 per household.

actors.name: Marian Prowse
actors.private_context: Marian owns Cove Cottage and runs it out of a paper diary. She rang Ruth on Friday (presumably 11th September) to say a couple from Leeds have asked about that same week, and that she'll hold it until the end of Wednesday (16th September) but not a day longer; she wants the £600 deposit in her bank account by then. She is waiting for the deposit.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that a total of £600 has been deposited into Marian Prowse's bank account by 2026-09-16T23:59:59+01:00, regardless of who pays. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
